sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
4.5.6

Guests can now complete a purchase without being stopped, and members are no longer shown a blank customize panel. Sites running 4.5.4 also pick up the 4.5.5 fix, which was never published separately.

  • Guest checkout. A guest can check out normally. Signing in is only requested at the point a card is actually saved to the account, and it now opens the usual sign-in dialog instead of ending in an error message. The card details are re-read after signing in, so nothing has to be typed twice.
  • Club signup for guests follows the same path rather than dead-ending.
  • Customize panel. After a session lapsed, opening a shipment's customize view could leave the panel blank with no spinner and no error. The loaded shipment now survives a brief authentication blip and only resets when a genuinely different member signs in.

No customer data, cart contents or orders are affected by this update.
